definitions.explanation: the act of inhaling and exhaling tobacco smoke

examples.japanese: {喫煙|きつえん}は{健康|けんこう}に{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Smoking is bad for your health.

examples.japanese: {喫煙|きつえん}{所|じょ}はどこですか。
{公共|こうきょう}{施設|しせつ}での{喫煙|きつえん}は{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Smoking in public facilities is prohibited.

notes:
{喫煙|きつえん} is the formal term for smoking, commonly used in public signage and official contexts.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {喫|きつ} (to consume, to drink/smoke)
- {煙|えん} (smoke)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {喫煙|きつえん}{所|じょ}/{喫煙|きつえん}{室|しつ} (smoking area/room)
- {喫煙|きつえん}{者|しゃ} (smoker)
- {喫煙|きつえん}{席|せき} (smoking seats)
- {喫煙|きつえん}{習慣|しゅうかん} (smoking habit)
- {受動|じゅどう}{喫煙|きつえん} (passive smoking, secondhand smoke)

USAGE:
- {喫煙|きつえん}する (to smoke - suru verb)
- {喫煙|きつえん}{可|か} (smoking allowed)
- {喫煙|きつえん}{不可|ふか} (no smoking)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has increasingly restricted smoking in public spaces. Many train stations, restaurants, and public buildings now have designated {喫煙|きつえん}{所|じょ} (smoking areas) or are entirely {禁煙|きんえん} (non-smoking).
